Andrea — appreciate the quick turnaround. Recommended plan below (keeps with our legal checklist and your witness requirement):

1) Signer order (sequential): CEO (Andrea) -> CFO (Marcus) -> Witness (witness signs a designated "Witness" tab attached to CFO page).
2) DocuSign settings: recipient authentication via email + SMS OTP for Marcus; enable "Requires in-person witness" on the witness tab so we capture the witness name and timestamp.
3) Fallback: add an optional recipient slot (CFO_Alternate) that becomes active if Marcus does not sign within 72 hours. Please supply alternative signer name/email if you want fallback.
4) Certificate of Authority: a scanned COA is fine; if your counsel requires notarization we can accept that too. Please upload POA or notarized COA to the secure share link below so our legal team can validate signer authority before envelope send.
5) Final artifacts: after all signatures, we publish the clean PDF to an S3 bucket and email copies to all signers + procurement. We can also drop the file into your shared Box folder if you prefer.

I created a draft envelope and will not send until you confirm final signer emails and the fallback account. Draft: https://app.docusign.com/envelope/draft/0a1b2c3d4e
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/CLAR-2026-042

Attaching our execution checklist for clarity.

Ben

Ben / Andrea — legal reviewed the redlines and we can proceed with Ben's approach. A couple of legal notes to include in the envelope metadata:

- We need a visible "Signer Capacity" field next to each signature (e.g., "CEO / Authorized Signatory").
- For the CFO witness, please have the witness initial the signature page and include witness contact (phone) for the audit trail.
- If you upload a POA for an alternate signer, include the effective date and expiration date in the file name (e.g., "POA_MarcusBell_EFFECTIVE20260101_EXP20271231.pdf").

Ben: please enable the DocuSign setting to prevent the envelope from auto-correcting recipient emails (we want to ensure we have exact matches to supplied addresses). Also, set the envelope to retain a full DocuSign audit CSV for our records.

If Andrea confirms the three files (COA, POA if applicable, final signer emails) we'll produce the envelope and target a Tuesday morning signing window.

Thanks — Karthik
